thread:
jamie: Morning — quick async check for Q2 triage (what I did / blockers / today).

lee: Pushed a spec draft for route-priority to the docs board. TL;DR: prefer low-latency variants by default, fall back to cost-optimized when load>threshold.

lee: Spec snippet:
```
- API: POST /v2/infer/route
- body: { model_variant: string, prefer_latency: bool }
- fallback: variant_aliases -> cost_optimized
```

sanjay: Working on batching Q/C — hit a flaky test in kv-cache integration. reproduces locally 1/5 runs. blocking CI. ping @maria for a quick review if I push a test-only fix.

maria: I can review after standup. saw a perf delta in the last run (+8% P95) — likely from a serialization change in the PR. I'll comment on the PR.

alex: Canary deployment shows 3/4 checks passed; saw two short latency spikes (90th->310ms). tagging infra team for trace.

deploy-bot: Canary 2026-03-05T09:12Z: checks=3/4; status=partial-pass; logs -> https://ci.example/redwood/canary/8732 :warning:

jamie: Question for product: do we push embed-cache v2 out of GA to reduce scope? v1 gives most of value and shaves a lot of risk.

maria: +1 to shipping v1 only for GA. v2 has model-switching complexity — we should scope it as follow-up.

lee: I'll slice the spec: GA = embed-cache-v1 (prefix caching + TTL), v2 = model-aware routing. Creating two tickets and reassigning owners. @sanjay would you take the v1 test fixes first?

sanjay: Yep, will finish the test fix by noon and open a PR. Need a short review from @maria and then we'll re-run canary.

alex: Added a roadmap card for the scope change and updated expected ship week. Also added a changelog blurb.

jamie: Plan for today: 1) land lee's spec split, 2) sanjay lands test fix + re-run canary, 3) maria reviews perf regression and we decide if rollback needed. Blockers: none other than the flaky test and canary spikes.

jamie: Thanks team :rocket: If anyone needs to sync live, ping me and I can jump on a 15-min.
